reason: The north-only restriction is unjustified, but I re-ran the model on the full sample and in each region. With pre-period controls the coefficient is near zero everywhere (full sample 0.06, SE 0.25; regions -0.5 to 0.4, all p>0.2), so 'no effect' holds. The raw positive association disappears once lagged growth is controlled, and adding the other pre-period covariates changes nothing.
